item.title: 'I've sneezed about 17 times today': Allergy season rips across Sacramento in full force
item.description: (FOX40.COM) -- The sun has been out and so has the pollen. Allergy season is officially underway in Northern California. item.title: Most Democrats stay in governor race despite political pressure
item.description: (Inside California Politics) — Despite pressure to drop out, most low-polling Democratic candidates for governor are staying in the race. Friday was California's filing deadline for the 2026 midterm elections. item.title: Newsom to spend $19M on California brand clean-up campaign
item.description: As speculation swirls over a potential presidential run, Gavin Newsom is set to spend $19 million on a marketing campaign to clean up California’s brand.
